title: Development and Evaluation of Quercetin-Loaded Phytosomal Hydrogel for Psoriasis Therapy: A Review
venue: International journal of pharmaceutical research and applications
abstract:
Psoriasis is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder with
a significant impact on the quality of life of affected
individuals. The management of psoriasis remains
challenging due to limitations associated with
conventional treatments such as systemic therapies
and topical corticosteroids. Recent advancements in
drug delivery systems, specifically the development
of phytosomal formulations, offer promising
alternatives for the treatment of psoriasis. This review
discusses the development of quercetin-loaded
phytosomal hydrogel as a novel therapeutic approach
for psoriasis. We examine the role of quercetin as an
anti-inflammatory agent, its formulation into
phytosomes for improved bioavailability, and the
benefits of using hydrogel-based delivery systems for
enhanced skin penetration and sustained release. The
paper also highlights the challenges, current research
findings, and potential clinical applications of this
formulation.
